plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero for capital preservation.
Sell SMH, CRWD, and METU due to being below stops or high beta.
Maintain SPY and QQQ as core broad index holdings.
Initiate a small position in VRT, a top-quality scanner setup, to diversify.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta exposure. Expect lower drawdowns but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the mandate and reduce concentration.
Sell SMH and METU due to being below stops and high beta.
Trim CRWD to 5% to reduce single-name concentration.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero to reduce overall leverage.
Maintain SPY and QQQ as core broad index holdings.
Initiate a small position in VRT, a strong scanner setup, for diversification.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while maintaining exposure to quality tech and broad indices. Expect moderate drawdowns with reasonable growth potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the mandate and free up capital.
Sell SMH, METU, and SPAL due to being below stops.
Add to CRWD, pressing a position that is working well.
Add to SOXL, increasing leveraged exposure in semiconductors.
Maintain SPY and QQQ as core broad index holdings.
Initiate a position in VRT, a top-scoring scanner setup, for growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware of significantly higher drawdown potential and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs.

plan: Add to QQQI, increasing exposure to income-generating ETFs.
Trim SPY and sell QQQ to reduce broad index growth exposure.
Sell all high-beta single names (CRWD, METU) and semiconductors (SMH).
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to near zero.
Prioritize low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It rotates heavily into income-generating ETFs and cuts high-beta exposure. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
